newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian stocks open up a touch on few leads.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian stocks open up a touch on few leads.

text.p: The Australian share market opened slightly higher on Monday on light volume after local investors were given few leads in the absence of U.S. financial markets which were closed for the Labor Day holiday.
At 10.30 a.m. (0030 GMT), the All Ordinaries index was 1.2 points higher at 2,257.9.
The June share price index was up two points at 2,256 and at a 1.9 point discount to the underlying index.
Brokers said investors were doubly cautious due to market speculation of a possible interest rate cut on Wednesday following today's Reserve Bank board meeting.
"It's been very quiet so far and I imagine this will be the tone for the whole day," a dealer from a Melbourne brokerage said.
The dealer said it was also a quiet day for reporting, with only a few major companies expected to release results.
"Basically there is no news around to drive the market and as long as there is some uncertainty about interest rates then trade will be slow," the dealer said.

The resource sector underpinned the market's early marginal gains with the solid fuels sector the best performing of the miners. Industrial issues were held back by a weak showing from the paper and engineering sectors.
